faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Mandi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Mandi Deputy Registrar / Assistant Registrar posts is 28 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Deputy Registrar / Assistant Registrar posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced by IIT Mandi for the Deputy Registrar and Assistant Registrar positions. This includes 1 for Deputy Registrar and 3 for Assistant Registrar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent Grade 'B' in the UGC 7-point scale. Relevant administrative experience is also a key requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary scale for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be appointed at Salary Level-12 for the Deputy Registrar post and Level-10 for the Assistant Registrar post, as per the IIT Mandi pay scales.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for IIT Mandi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay ₹1000, while SC/ST and Women candidates are required to pay ₹500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves Screening, followed by a Written Test, Trade Test, and finally Document Verification to assess the suitability of candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Himachal Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications from eligible candidates in Himachal Pradesh. However, it is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification for any specific residency requirements.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age relaxation provided for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is provided as per government rules: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC(NCL), and applicable relaxations for PwD/Ex-servicemen. Regular IIT employees can apply up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for IIT Mandi Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.

faq.question: Q10. How do I apply for the IIT Mandi Deputy Registrar / Assistant Registrar posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT Mandi or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the closing date of 28 August 2026.
